metadata.build: nix develop; cargo build -p mark-bench --release --locked; default features; mimalloc; codegen-units=1; lto=thin; panic=abort; no PGO or allocation profiler
metadata.order: Before/after on odd rounds; after/before on even rounds; sequential fresh processes, no concurrent builds/tests, no affinity or CPU governor changes.
metadata.scope_memory_note: Estimates changed with the adapter; private Syntaxmate capacities and internal style cache are not observable. Scope-table estimates and cache counters are not directly comparable across versions. Peak RSS uses Linux wait4 ru_maxrss for the entire fresh process.
metadata.config: Isolated XDG_CONFIG_HOME with theme=github-dark and a keyword foreground=#ff00ff/bold rule. measure intentionally ignores user theme settings; MARK_TEXTMATE_BENCH_THEME=github-dark enables the base theme only. Scope overrides were verified separately with tests and syntax inspect.
notes: Raw first pass includes lazy tokenizer construction plus Mark scope adaptation, excludes catalog detection, file I/O and theme rendering.
Thirty-pass timings include first-use cost, with a reused highlighter and its default line cache; divide highlight_micros by 30 to obtain amortized time.
TUI suite runs plain mode then syntax mode in each process; global caches may already be initialized by plain mode. Each scenario has its own process.
Minified Rust is a resource-limit control and completes no highlight jobs.
Initial unthemed TUI pilot samples are excluded; raw syntax samples are unchanged.
